verses.text: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb.
verses.title: Inspired by Bible Stories

verses.text: God’s voice thunders in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding. He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the rain shower, ‘Be a mighty downpour.’
Give us today our daily bread.
